documents.name: Cloud Service Agreement
documents.summary: Terms for selling and buying a cloud software or SaaS subscription.
documents.useFor: SaaS, cloud software subscription, terms of service, selling or buying hosted software

fields.label: Cloud Service
fields.description: The cloud product or SaaS being sold, e.g. "Acme Analytics, Enterprise plan".

fields.label: Order Date
fields.description: The date this Order Form starts.

fields.label: Subscription Period
fields.description: How long the subscription lasts, e.g. "12 months from the Order Date".

fields.label: Non-Renewal Notice Date
fields.description: Deadline to give notice of non-renewal, e.g. "30 days before the end of the Subscription Period".

fields.label: Fees
fields.description: Price and billing, e.g. "$1,000 per month, billed annually in advance".

fields.label: Technical Support
fields.description: Support the Provider gives, e.g. "Email support on business days, 9am-5pm ET".

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: The date the agreement starts.

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.description: The jurisdiction whose laws govern, e.g. "Delaware".

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.description: Courts for disputes, e.g. "the state or federal courts in New Castle County, Delaware".

fields.label: General Cap Amount
fields.description: Liability cap, e.g. "the fees paid or payable in the 12 months before the claim".

fields.label: Provider Covered Claims
fields.description: Third-party claims the Provider indemnifies, e.g. "claims that the Cloud Service infringes intellectual property rights".

fields.label: Customer Covered Claims
fields.description: Third-party claims the Customer indemnifies, e.g. "claims arising from Customer Content".

fields.label: DPA
fields.description: The data processing agreement between the parties, if any, e.g. "Common Paper DPA signed on the Effective Date".

documents.name: Service Level Agreement
documents.summary: Uptime and support response targets with service credits, used together with a Cloud Service Agreement.
documents.useFor: SLA, uptime guarantee, availability, support response times, service credits

fields.label: Subscription Period
fields.description: The subscription period the SLA covers, e.g. "12 months from the Order Date".

fields.label: Target Uptime
fields.description: Monthly availability target, e.g. "99.9%".

fields.label: Target Response Time
fields.description: Time to acknowledge a support request, e.g. "4 business hours".

fields.label: Support Channel
fields.description: Where support requests go, e.g. "support@provider.com".

fields.label: Uptime Credit
fields.description: Credit when uptime is missed, e.g. "10% of the monthly fees".

fields.label: Response Time Credit
fields.description: Credit when the response time is missed, e.g. "5% of the monthly fees".

fields.label: Scheduled Downtime
fields.description: Planned maintenance windows excluded from uptime, e.g. "Sundays 2-4am UTC, with 48 hours' notice".

documents.name: Data Processing Agreement
documents.summary: How a provider processes customer personal data as a processor, including security, subprocessors and international transfers (GDPR).
documents.useFor: DPA, GDPR, personal data processing, data protection addendum, subprocessors

fields.label: Agreement
fields.description: The main agreement this DPA supplements, e.g. "the Cloud Service Agreement dated March 1, 2026".

fields.label: Nature and Purpose of Processing
fields.description: What the Provider does with the personal data and why, e.g. "hosting and analysing customer usage data to provide the Cloud Service".

fields.label: Duration of Processing
fields.description: How long data is processed, e.g. "for the term of the Agreement".

fields.label: Frequency of Transfer
fields.description: How often data is transferred, e.g. "continuous".

fields.label: Categories of Data Subjects
fields.description: Whose data, e.g. "Customer's employees and end users".

fields.label: Categories of Personal Data
fields.description: What data, e.g. "names, email addresses, IP addresses".

fields.label: Special Category Data
fields.description: Sensitive data processed, e.g. health data, or "None".

fields.label: Special Category Data Restrictions or Safeguards
fields.description: Extra safeguards for special category data.

fields.label: Approved Subprocessors
fields.description: Subprocessors the Customer approves, with country and task, e.g. "Amazon Web Services (USA, hosting)".

fields.label: Governing Member State
fields.description: EU member state whose law governs the Standard Contractual Clauses, e.g. "Ireland".

fields.label: Security Policy
fields.description: The Provider's security policy, e.g. a URL or document name.

fields.label: Provider Security Contact
fields.description: Who to contact about security incidents, e.g. "security@provider.com".

documents.summary: Adds AI-specific terms to a commercial agreement: inputs, outputs, model training and related responsibilities.
documents.useFor: AI, artificial intelligence, machine learning, model training on customer data, AI features

fields.label: Agreement
fields.description: The commercial agreement this addendum supplements, e.g. "the Cloud Service Agreement dated March 1, 2026".

fields.description: Customer data the Provider may use to train models. Leave empty if no training is allowed.

fields.label: Training Purposes
